description: Exercise C-delta-prefix by reconnecting a follower with decided=accepted=1 after the leader and another follower decide a second entry. Delta is generated by target code with boundary 2. Compare full recovered content to independently read leader decided prefix.

harness.description: Three public OmniPaxos instances, genuine FIFO transport messages, one temporary node partition and reconnect notification. Record prerequisites, Delta dispatch, Accepted completion and synchronous decided reads.
semantic_changes: No target code changes. A deterministic caller-owned transport models the documented external network boundary. Snapshot is a content-preserving vector with concatenate merge.

legality.derivation: Three fresh public OmniPaxos nodes use the actual MemoryStorage. try_become_leader performs real preparation. A FIFO queue drains genuine target messages. Append 11 reaches decision everywhere; an all-message transport partition isolates node 3 while nodes 1 and 2 decide 22. Restoring the link precedes node3.reconnected(1), matching M-api and the disconnect/reconnect pattern in M-sync-test. No protocol message is constructed or rewritten. The actual Promise witnesses receiver boundaries; actual AcceptSync must carry Delta and matching promised ballot. The handler return and emitted Accepted acknowledge completion; synchronous public reads then observe the live receiver under exclusive ownership.
legality.applicability: Single-threaded explicit network scheduler; no wall-clock waits or concurrent mutations. No tick is required between these finite synchronous calls; the check does not assert eventual progress or a time deadline. Snapshot payload is an ordered content vector matching the repository ValueSnapshot concatenation semantics.
alternatives: Full prefix comparison intentionally differs from the repository latest-value-only equality; this strengthens observation without changing the underlying content-preservation requirement.

grounding.derivation: prefix_ready records actual leader decided content after a majority and receiver old state are checked. sync_admitted is emitted before delivering the authentic matching-ballot Delta. sync_result reads the same receiver after the handler and its actual Accepted response. Compare all expanded snapshot/log values against the measured leader prefix, not snapshot length or last value.
grounding.applicability: Identity case/receiver/sync_id is independent of content and stable through recovery. Completed means the target emitted matching-ballot Accepted at the requested boundary and remains in Accept; absence of that result cannot establish holds.

observable_properties.description: After acknowledged Delta recovery, full ordered decided contents equal the independently established decided leader prefix.

uncertainties: One concrete receiver-lag case; no universal coverage of leader-side synchronization, already accepted suffix overlap, or compacted receiver variants.
Compilation and fixed execution are pending.
